Random traffic saturates near 0.27 of peak (section 3), so its curve stops at 0.3.

## 6. Why 'bandwidth x efficiency' is not one number

On one HBM pseudo-channel with one controller (FR-FCFS, open page), achieved efficiency ranges from 0.10 to 0.93 across the six patterns of section 3. A single derating factor is right for at most one traffic mix, one mapping and one load.
